title: El cacique Guatavita y la leyenda de El Dorado — Juan Rodríguez Freyle excerpt
creator: Juan Rodríguez Freyle
provenance: Banco de la República digital collection reproducing Freyle's El Carnero passage on Guatavita and El Dorado.
notes: Freyle states that don Juan, cacique and lord of Guatavita, told him the relevant antiquities/traditions.
This is evidence for Freyle's recorded version and claimed informant chain, not direct archaeological proof of the pre-contact ceremony.
